principle_violations.reason: The Order class combines responsibilities of managing items and processing payments, violating SRP. Each class should have a single reason to change.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the payment processing functionality from the Order management. Create a dedicated class for payment processing operations.

principle_violations.suggestion: Implement a factory pattern or an external service that can handle payment processing without needing to modify existing classes.
